data.name: SymbolInvalid
data.value: An AMQP symbol must be non-null seven-bit ASCII text.

data.name: DescriptorTypeInvalid
data.value: An AMQP descriptor must be a symbol or an unsigned long.

data.name: MessageIdTypeInvalid
data.value: An AMQP message or correlation identifier must be an unsigned long, a GUID, binary data or a string.

data.name: BodySectionsEmpty
data.value: An AMQP message body must have at least one section.

data.name: DeliveryTagTooLong
data.value: An AMQP delivery tag must be at most 32 bytes long.

data.name: PlainCredentialInvalid
data.value: A SASL PLAIN user name, password or authorization identity cannot contain a NUL character.

data.name: CoordinatorTargetRequired
data.value: The link's target must be a transaction coordinator.

data.name: TransactionDeclareRefused
data.value: The transaction coordinator refused to declare a transaction.

data.name: TransactionDischargeRefused
data.value: The transaction coordinator refused to discharge the transaction.

data.name: TransactionOutcomeUnexpected
data.value: The transaction coordinator answered with the unexpected outcome '{0}'.

data.name: ExpiryPolicyInvalid
data.value: The terminus expiry policy must be one AMQP 1.0 defines: link-detach, session-end, connection-close or never.

data.name: CoordinatorRequestRequired
data.value: The link request must come from a sender attaching to a transaction coordinator.

data.name: CoordinatorAlreadyRunning
data.value: The transaction coordinator has already run.

data.name: CoordinatorMessageInvalid
data.value: A transaction coordinator handles only a declare or a discharge in an amqp-value body.

data.name: CoordinatorHandlerFailed
data.value: The transactional resource failed while it handled a declare or discharge.

data.name: TransactionIdTooLong
data.value: The transaction handler declared an identifier longer than the 32 bytes AMQP 1.0 allows.

data.name: TransactionIdDuplicate
data.value: The transaction handler declared an identifier that names a transaction still live on the control link.

data.name: TransactionUnknown
data.value: The control link did not declare the transaction, or already discharged it.

data.name: CoordinatorCapabilityMissing
data.value: The transaction coordinator does not support the capability '{0}'.
